assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
There was a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered
The service is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmic cause of the transient cerebral ischemic attack
The service is medically necessary to guide rate control in the setting of sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease
